GOAL: fix a coupling position for round-3 ideation (agent 5) that is not any prior-round mechanism and that attacks the measured failure (deep-prefix capacity loss), under frozen Stage2/Stage3 budgets.
READ: no filesystem or repo access in this session (read/. and read of the round directory both rejected with permission denied); no shell, no browser. All evidence therefore comes from the round brief: round1 curved residual 251/1769/2201, test_recall@10 0.0544; round2 population-scaled geodesic step toward popularity-adjusted successor barycentre 230/1251/1298, 0.0517; frozen baseline 0.0679; gate 0.065; rejects listed (BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, CURVCTRL-SID, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, BRad-RQ, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID).
OBSERVED (arithmetic on the brief's own prefix counts): 251 distinct L1, 1769 distinct L2 pairs, 2201 distinct L3 triples at 24556 items => 1.24 distinct L3 codes per L2 pair and ~13.9 items per L2 pair. The third token is very nearly a deterministic function of the second, i.e. the deepest level is redundant, while every mechanism tried so far reduced the number of distinct triples rather than the redundancy.
REASONING: therefore the only admissible direction is to change WHERE the behaviour term acts (decision boundary of the deepest level, not item positions), to use a centred/contrast behaviour object (structural removal of the popularity-hub attraction that produced round2's collapse), and to spend the once-licensed capacity change (L3 codewords 256->512) only through the behaviour term so the extra codes are not near-duplicates.
STILL OPEN: whether the behaviour direction is strong enough for the extra 256 L3 codes to be occupied; whether the geodesic midpoint's radius contraction leaves curvature active (must be reported, not tuned).

FINAL ANSWER (BCMID-L3-RQ), summary: deep level-3 SID token chosen against a Lorentz geodesic midpoint between the level-3 content residual point and a per-item centred successor-contrast behaviour point in the unit Poincare ball, with 512 L3 codewords and exact hyperbolic nearest-codeword via the Klein power diagram score gamma_k(<K(a),K(q_k)>-1) = -gamma_a cosh(d_c). Behaviour = train-only transition rows minus global successor marginal, truncated SVD, fixed projection, norm-matched by measured median R_b; aperture R = median L3 residual norm. No point displacement (unlike round 2), geometry acts on the address and boundary only; loss unchanged so the token and the encoder both carry behaviour through straight-through commitment. Derived constants only (two medians, 90% singular energy rank, fixed c=1, 512 = 2x frozen 256 licensed by the capacity analysis). Cost <1% per step (33.5M MAC matmul at 1024x512x64, ~0.151 s/epoch, ~452 s total). Switches exist: behaviour-off sets S^=0 (address = content point); geometry-off uses identity exp, arithmetic mean and Euclidean argmin keeping 512 codes. Observables: distinct L3 prefixes (expect >=4000 vs 2201), L3 per L2 pair (>=2 vs 1.24), 512-code occupancy, within-prefix successor entropy, median address vs content radius (curvature liveness), end-of-training behaviour flip fraction (>=20%), Stage3 test_recall@10 vs gate 0.065 and frozen baseline 0.0679. Full verbatim block was printed in the reply; storage rejected it for length.

STAGE: slot selection for a third ideation answer (this agent's SECOND distinct idea this round).
GOAL: choose a coupling position that the two negative rounds and the rejected-proposal list have not occupied.
READ: the round-three brief (round1 curved-residual chain 0.05439 at L1/L2/L3 prefixes 251/1769/2201; round2 concentration-scaled geodesic step to popularity-adjusted successor barycentre 0.05165 at prefixes 230/1251/1298; gate 0.065, frozen baseline approx 0.0679), plus the constraint list (tree-ness unavailable via degree-preserving rewiring; curvature is a gauge; behaviour-contrast predicts recall while Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt; origin-minimum collapses the encoder; behaviour must reach the TOKENS) and the rejected list (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, BRad-RQ, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS).
OBSERVED: both trained rounds are prefix-MERGING mechanisms and both lost recall; the only quantity that separated them is deep-level prefix count (2201 vs 1298). Every rejected idea also edits the existing 3x256 partition (radial entropy scaling, successor barycentre pulling, Fréchet codebook updates, curvature per level). Nothing in the list ADDS a refinement level while leaving levels 1-3 bit-identical.
REASONING: the highest-value unoccupied position is a capacity-ADDITIVE one: keep the 3x256 SID prefix exactly as frozen (so the 2201-prefix capacity cannot be destroyed) and put the behaviour x curvature coupling entirely into a NEW fourth token, so the coupled pathway can only add partition detail. That also removes the structural risk that killed rounds one and two (hub attraction merging prefixes), because the new level cannot re-merge tokens at levels 1-3.
OPEN: whether a 64-codeword fourth level fits the 0.15 s/epoch budget (it adds 8.3% of the baseline per-item distance count) and whether the behaviour profile can be built train-only without touching val/test. ANSWERED in the next record.

STAGE: final answer (this agent's second distinct idea this round) - BEHDIR-L4.
GOAL: emit one implementable, in-scope mechanism and the progress record for it.
READ: round-three brief, scope contract, capacity evidence (2201 vs 1298 L3 prefixes trace 0.0544 vs 0.0517), the ban on tuning/ablation/seed arms, the rejected-idea list.
OBSERVED: every trained and rejected mechanism edits the existing 3x256 partition and spends its capacity; nothing added refinement while leaving levels 1-3 bit-identical.
DESIGN (the answer, printed in the reply): keep the frozen 3x256 prefix unchanged, add a 64-codeword fourth level. At prefix p_i take t_i = log_{p_i}(x_i), metric-normalise by 1/lambda(p_i), mix its unit direction with a fixed orthonormal projection of the item's train-only rank-32 successor PPMI profile under a bounded gate 1+tanh(W b_i), W init 0, walk a clamped learnable geodesic distance s from p_i with exp_{p_i}, and take the nearest of 64 ball codewords by d_P. No new loss term means no coupling weight to tune; removing either the behaviour terms (b_i, P, W) or the curved operations (log_p, lambda, exp_p, d_P) changes the emitted token.
COST: 768 -> 832 per-item distances per step (+8.3%), one extra log/exp per item, d x 32 matrices; est. 0.15 -> approx 0.165 s per epoch, inside the frozen Stage-2 budget.
EVIDENCE: the answer block in the reply is the deliverable.
OPEN: whether level-4 refinement lifts Stage-3 test_recall@10 above 0.065; single-arm by policy, so the in-run signature (L4 distinct count rising while 251/1769/2201 stay fixed, level-4 reconstruction share non-trivial, s and |W| away from clamps) is the diagnostic to log.
